HOLDYOURTURN-TURN_HOLD_TIME.title: Turn Hold Duration
HOLDYOURTURN-TURN_HOLD_TIME.hover.desc: Whenever you gain extra Energy or an extra card draw, the End Turn button is locked for the duration set here.
When another player uses a potion that affects you, treat it like gaining extra Energy or a card draw: the End Turn button is locked, and in multiplayer your already-ended turn is undone.
HOLDYOURTURN-SMART_MODE.title: Smart Mode
HOLDYOURTURN-SMART_MODE.hover.desc:
Experimental: temporarily suspends turn-end protection when you have no playable cards in hand and no potions that grant Energy or additional cards.
Please help improve these checks through Workshop comments.
